Name: Porg Blue Chicken Replacement
Author: Ixanna
Description: Redesigns and recolors your blue chickens into porgs. This download includes both the blue chicken adult and chick but if you rename the file it can be used for all the chickens in the game. It's been tested and works well, looks super cute too. Dewback pig redesign as well as a bantha redesign for the goats and a loth cat redesign for the rabbits are coming soon.
